projectContext: Continue improving YouTube download resilience. Sprint 2 established core retry mechanisms, circuit breaker, batch retry queue, speed tracking, and metrics. Sprint 3 focuses on cross-component coordination, per-tier isolation, proactive rate limit detection, and checkpoint persistence improvements. Key gaps: rate limit state is global (not per-tier), circuit breaker and batch retry don't coordinate, VPN manager state not persisted, metrics not loaded on resume, cookie cooldown and batch retry delays not synchronized.

userStories.title: Implement per-tier rate limit state isolation
userStories.description: Rate limiting state (backoff count, delay, cooldown mode) is tracked globally. When downloading multiple tiers simultaneously, a rate limit on 'long' tier affects 'short' tier backoff. Each tier should maintain independent rate limit state.
acceptanceCriteria: New TierRateLimitState class tracks backoff_count, current_delay, in_recovery for each tier
RateLimitConfig gains per_tier_isolation option (default: true)
handle_rate_limit_error() uses tier-specific state when isolation enabled
_reset_rate_limit_backoff() resets only the affected tier's state
Rate limit metrics track events per tier in tier_rate_limit_events dict
Tests verify tier A rate limit does not affect tier B backoff
userStories.notes: Implemented TierRateLimitState dataclass, added per_tier_isolation config option (default: true), updated handle_rate_limit_error() and _reset_rate_limit_backoff() for tier-specific state, added tier_rate_limit_events to metrics. 25 tests verify isolation behavior.

userStories.title: Add proactive rate limit detection via speed drop monitoring
userStories.description: Speed tracker monitors download speeds but doesn't signal potential rate limiting. A sudden drop to near-zero or stalled progress often precedes hard rate limit failures. Add proactive detection.
acceptanceCriteria: SpeedTracker gains detect_rate_limit_signals() method checking for speed anomalies
New config option speed_tracking.rate_limit_signal_threshold (default: 0.1 Mbps)
When speed drops below threshold for 3+ consecutive samples, emit rate_limit_signal
Signal triggers preemptive backoff via circuit breaker integration
Signal logged at WARNING level with speed history context
Tests verify signal detection and preemptive action
userStories.notes: Implemented detect_rate_limit_signals() method returning RateLimitSignal dataclass with detection status and speed history. Added rate_limit_signal_threshold (0.1 MB/s) and consecutive_slow_samples (3) config options. Integrated with circuit breaker in core.py to trigger preemptive backoff when signal detected. 20 new tests cover signal detection, logging, circuit breaker integration, and edge cases.

userStories.title: Coordinate circuit breaker pause with batch retry scheduling
userStories.description: Circuit breaker pauses for 60s after failures, but batch retry queue has its own 120s delay. If circuit breaker is paused, batch retry should wait for it to recover before processing.
acceptanceCriteria: RetryQueue gains set_circuit_breaker() method to link to circuit breaker instance
Before processing batch retry, check if circuit breaker is tripped
If tripped, wait for circuit breaker pause to complete before retry
New config option batch_retry.respect_circuit_breaker (default: true)
Batch retry delay extends if circuit breaker pause overlaps
Tests verify batch retry waits for circuit breaker recovery

userStories.title: Add cross-keyword rate limit budget tracking
userStories.description: When processing multiple keywords, rate limit events from keyword A are not shared with keyword B. If keyword A exhausted cookie rotations, keyword B doesn't know. Add shared rate limit budget.
acceptanceCriteria: New RateLimitBudget class tracks: rotations_used, vpn_switches_used, backoff_time_spent
Budget shared across all keywords in a download session
New config option rate_limit.share_budget_across_keywords (default: true)
When budget exhausted (e.g., all rotations used), skip to next escalation level
Budget state saved to checkpoint for resume
Tests verify keyword B skips exhausted rotations from keyword A

userStories.title: Add VPN manager checkpoint persistence
userStories.description: VPN manager tracks switch_count in memory but doesn't persist to checkpoint. On resume, switch count is lost and may exceed max_switches_per_session.
acceptanceCriteria: VpnManager gains to_checkpoint_state() and from_checkpoint_state() methods
Checkpoint includes vpn_manager_state with switch_count, last_switch_timestamp
On resume, VpnManager loads previous state and continues tracking
max_switches_per_session enforced across resume boundaries
Status logged on resume: 'Resuming VPN manager: X/Y switches used'
Tests verify switch count preserved across checkpoint save/load

userStories.title: Implement rate limit metrics aggregation on resume
userStories.description: Rate limit metrics are saved to checkpoint but not loaded on resume. Users can't see cumulative metrics across session boundaries for multi-day downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: RateLimitMetrics gains from_checkpoint() classmethod to load previous state
On resume, metrics loaded and aggregation continues from previous values
New session_count field tracks how many sessions contributed to metrics
Cross-session metrics distinguished in report (e.g., 'Total across 3 sessions')
Metrics reset method clears all values including session count
Tests verify cumulative metrics across multiple save/load cycles

userStories.title: Synchronize cookie cooldown with batch retry delay
userStories.description: Cookie rotation tracks per-cookie cooldown (300s), batch retry has 120s delay. If a cookie fails, batch retry might reuse it before cooldown expires. Synchronize these delays.
acceptanceCriteria: RetryQueue gains set_cookie_rotator() method to access cooldown info
Before batch retry, check if any required cookies are in cooldown
If cookies in cooldown, extend batch retry delay to wait for cooldown expiry
New config option batch_retry.wait_for_cookie_cooldown (default: true)
Log when batch retry delay extended due to cookie cooldown
Tests verify batch retry waits for cookie cooldown expiry

userStories.title: Add adaptive backoff multiplier based on error severity
userStories.description: Rate limit backoff uses fixed 2.0 multiplier regardless of error type. A 429 quota exceeded should use higher multiplier than 'too many requests'. Add severity-based adjustment.
acceptanceCriteria: New error_severity dict maps error patterns to severity levels (low, medium, high)
Backoff multiplier adjusted based on severity: low=1.5, medium=2.0, high=3.0
New config option rate_limit.adaptive_multiplier (default: true)
Severity classification logged with each rate limit event
Metrics track backoff events by severity level
Tests verify different multipliers applied for different error types

userStories.title: Add per-keyword rate limit event tracking in metrics
userStories.description: Metrics aggregate rate limit events globally but don't track which keywords trigger the most. Keyword-level metrics help identify problematic search terms.
acceptanceCriteria: RateLimitMetrics gains keyword_rate_limit_events dict tracking events per keyword
record_rate_limit_event() accepts optional keyword parameter
Report shows top 5 keywords by rate limit events when > 10 events total
Config recommendation suggests skipping high-rate-limit keywords
Keyword events saved to checkpoint for cross-session analysis
Tests verify per-keyword tracking and report output

userStories.title: Add configurable VPN connection verification endpoint
userStories.description: VPN manager verifies connection by pinging Google (8.8.8.8). For privacy-conscious users, this leaks connection tests to Google. Make endpoint configurable.
acceptanceCriteria: New config option vpn.verification_endpoint (default: 'https://www.google.com')
New config option vpn.verification_ip (default: '8.8.8.8')
VpnManager uses configured endpoints instead of hardcoded Google
Option to disable verification entirely: vpn.skip_verification (default: false)
Verification failure logged with endpoint used
Tests verify custom endpoints are used for verification

userStories.title: Implement download retry and circuit breaker timeout coordination
userStories.description: Download retry loop and circuit breaker operate independently. If circuit breaker pauses during a download retry, the two mechanisms don't coordinate. Add synchronization.
acceptanceCriteria: Download retry loop checks circuit breaker state before each attempt
If circuit breaker tripped during retry, wait for recovery before continuing
New config option circuit_breaker.block_download_retries (default: true)
Retry count preserved across circuit breaker pause (not reset)
Log when download retry paused due to circuit breaker
Tests verify download retry waits for circuit breaker recovery

userStories.title: Add rate limit health dashboard data export
userStories.description: Rate limit metrics are shown in pipeline report but not exportable. Add JSON export for external monitoring and visualization tools.
acceptanceCriteria: RateLimitMetrics gains export_to_json() method returning structured data
Export includes all metrics, timestamps, and session info
New CLI flag --export-metrics <path> saves metrics JSON after pipeline
JSON schema documented in rate_limit_metrics.py docstring
Export includes config values that were active during session
Tests verify JSON export matches expected schema
